def count_vowels_consonants(s):
    vowels = 'aeiouAEIOU'
    s = s.replace(" ", "")  # remove spaces to not count them as consonants
    num_vowels = sum(char in vowels for char in s)
    num_consonants = sum(char.isalpha() and char not in vowels for char in s)
    return num_vowels, num_consonants
